name: hud_ui_stats_list_element_destructor_core
description: HudUiStatsListElement::DestructorCore enters stats-list destructor dispatch state, destroys and frees the owned triplet when present, clears the triplet pointer, and restores base HudUiElement dispatch state.
known_limits: Tier C only; Binary Ninja shows VC exception-registration scaffolding around the owned triplet destructor/delete sequence, so tier S verification is deferred to a HUD stats-list class or source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x40fa40 validate the stats-list dispatch-table store, reading the owned triplet from offset 0x34, calling HudUiTriplet::DestructorCore and operator delete when the triplet is non-null, clearing offset 0x34, and restoring base HudUiElement dispatch state.

0x40e070 HudUiTriplet::DestructorCore is functionally equivalent under target hud_ui_triplet_destructor_core; operator delete and __ehhandler_HudUiStatsListElement_DestructorCore are accepted provider boundaries.
The native stats-list destructor smoke allocates an owned triplet, calls DestructorCore, and verifies the triplet pointer is cleared and base HudUiElement dispatch state is restored.
